question: Can original participant records verify a named source-literary adaptation permission or payment behind Matira Manisha?
answer: No source-author payment or contract was verified. The specific original-source access gap advanced: the exact Pati monograph, Kalindi autobiography and collected volume are now acquired; a Sen memoir excerpt and Abbas scan were located. No financial amount enters the public story.
why_this_is_new: Earlier work had only catalogue identity for Pati2001 and an uncorroborated retrospective. Public samplep65 supplied author-side archive targets; a direct catalogue read exposed three exact downloadable originals. These sources were not previously acquired in the cited payment route.

findings.evidence: Palit2025 reports Rs25000 for a1960rights transaction involving Abbas. This known retrospective claim has no pinpoint documentary reference. A bibliography mention of Pati does not establish which passage supplied the claim.
findings.disposition: No new payment verification; no figure/recipient/rights-scope inference.

findings.inspection: Title/imprint PDF1–4 and original printed65–66/PDF72–73 visually checked; bookseller samples title/contents and printed1,7,17,25,65 also read. OCR navigation generated for95pages; relevant text inspected selectively, not a complete manual reading.
findings.evidence: Original imprint resolves book identity. Printed65 directs readers to the autobiography and volume2 diary; printed66 describes school-age reading around1920.
findings.limits: No original payment record found in inspected material. OCR had one failed run with95nilError results; successful CPU retry has text on95pages. Neither keyword absence nor selected reading proves the book lacks a transaction elsewhere.

editorial_decision.public_change: None warranted by current payment evidence. Existing distinction between credits, book royalties, stage fees, remake rights and film-source compensation is sound.
editorial_decision.future_placement: If original payment/permission evidence emerges, Literature and Screen: What returned to the writer? Permission alone cannot close the payment question.
editorial_decision.reason: Research evidence/queue only; no article, media, layout or download source changed.
